description: This file defines the SugarFieldRelate class, a custom field type for handling related record relationships in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It includes methods for rendering detail views, edit views, and search views, as well as sanitizing import data related to relational fields.

classes.name: SugarFieldRelate
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase to implement related record field functionalities such as rendering views and sanitizing import data.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the detail view for the relate field, deciding whether to display as linked or plain text based on module.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the Smarty template for editing the relate field, handling popup data for selecting related records.

methods.name: getPopupViewSmarty
methods.description: Sets up data for the popup view to search and select related records.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the Smarty template for search view, allowing users to find related records.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats the display of contact name fields based on user locale preferences.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and processes import data related to relate fields, resolving related record IDs.
